title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
author: Parsa Esmati; Somjit Nath; Katja Hofmann; Derek Nowrouzezahrai; Samira Ebrahimi Kahou; Majid Mirmehdi
summary: Video diffusion models can internally represent physical laws even though they are not trained for this. Researchers recovered hidden model states by reversing the diffusion process on real videos. These internal states help the models distinguish physically plausible videos better than other methods.
